Acceptance criteria: Evidence tracking files committed and verified in private GitHub repository
Normalized sample feed ingested with passing reproducible tests
Risk scoring of benchmark dataset with documented outputs
Authorized remediation constrained by auditable policy
Separate recheck detects ineffective remediation and records evidence
Reproducible scenario with expected findings and verified outcomes
Authorized upload, assessment, review, and evidence export workflow tested
Validated installation and usage instructions, diagrams, API spec
Versioned tested release, evaluation report and external feedback
